answer.generated: Two primary design issues in distributed systems engineering are transparency and openness. Transparency concerns the extent to which a distributed system should appear to users as a single coherent entity, which can impact usability and user experience. Openness refers to the choice between designing the system using standard protocols that facilitate interoperability or specialized protocols that offer greater design flexibility but may limit compatibility with other systems.
